axes.model_access: The Doubao consumer app runs ByteDance’s Seed family. The official Seed 2.1 release lists Pro and Turbo tiers with 1M context and multimodal understanding. It also says the office-task mode on Doubao PC or the Doubao app is the way to try it. The Volcengine Ark model list carries `doubao-seed-2-1-pro-260915` and `doubao-seed-2-1-lite-260915`. Both are listed with 1024K context, multimodality, GUI and tool calling. A weekly `doubao-seed-evolving` is listed too. In-app tiers follow the signed-in interface (2026-11-21).
axes.runtime: Web at doubao.com, iOS/Android apps, the PC client and the Doubao Work desktop app all work. Generation runs in ByteDance’s cloud with no local model. Enterprise model APIs are a separate Volcengine Ark line (2026-11-21).
axes.local_files: Uploaded documents, images, recordings and generated files live account-side. The privacy policy states that PPT and writing outputs are saved automatically to cloud drive. Recording transcripts, original text and audio are also saved there. Documents are managed in cloud drive; downloads land locally (2026-11-21).
axes.background: Conversations stream. Office-task mode can plan several steps inside a session and produce documents, spreadsheets, PPTs and web pages. It is a foreground task, not an offline queue that resumes after shutdown. Recording transcription and meeting notes are processed in the cloud and saved to cloud drive (2026-11-21).
axes.tools: Chat handles text, voice, images and files, plus web search and document parsing. Output covers PPT, writing, spreadsheets, image and video generation. It also offers translation and simultaneous interpretation, recording transcription, screen sharing and video calls, coding and app publishing, and memory. The desktop app can operate a virtual desktop and browser and edit documents, PPTs and web pages in place (2026-11-21).
axes.context: Memory is on by default. It distils interests, preferences and habits from conversations into background for later replies. A switch under Settings → Memory allows per-item review or deletion and a “delete all” action. In-chat remember and forget commands also work. Memory is shared across devices on one account but isolated between accounts and agents. Turning the switch off stops new memories and their use without deleting existing ones (2026-11-21).
axes.permissions: The product uses accounts, with free and paid plans. §1.10 of the personal-edition privacy policy says inputs, instructions and replies may be analysed and used for model training after encryption, de-identification and non-reidentification. Users can opt out under Settings → Privacy & Permissions → Help improve the model in the app. On PC and web the switch is Settings → Help improve the model. Memory and cloud drive are managed separately; the API line follows Volcengine’s separate agreement (2026-11-21).
axes.fit: Fit: Chinese everyday Q&A and office output, integrated memory and cloud drive, synced app, PC and web, recording transcription and interpretation. Not fit: local models, free model switching, or contract-grade API data terms (use Volcengine Ark for those) (2026-11-21).
